title: CDS Photography
description: Landscape, wildlife, night-sky and travel photography.
aboutText:
I'm Chahat Singh, an amateur photographer based in Boulder, Colorado, chasing the quiet drama of the natural world — alpenglow on desert arches, the Milky Way over the Tetons, the amber stare of a wolf at last light.

Most of this collection was made across the national parks of the American West, with a handful of frames carried home from travels farther afield. If a photograph makes you slow down for a second, it has done its job.
